title: Resource Arguments and Tags
scenario: Resources are blocks with a type and a name. Complete an S3 bucket so the bucket name comes from a variable and the resource carries a Project tag.
constraints: Add a tags map with Project = "arena".

focus.title: Complete the bucket resource
focus.todo: Set the bucket argument and add the Project tag.

hints.why: HCL is the language Terraform evaluates. Small syntax mistakes here turn into confusing plan errors later, so slow, deliberate practice pays off.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `resource "aws_s3_bucket" "this"`. Set the bucket argument and add the Project tag. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Reach for this whenever you add a new block or argument by hand rather than copying generated code.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `resource "aws_s3_bucket" "this"`. Use this code shape: bucket; tags. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `var.bucket_name`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.

test_manifest.title: bucket name comes from the variable
